narrative: The technology landscape is buzzing with advancements in AI, particularly in agentic systems and open models, while infrastructure providers focus on scaling compute and enhancing security. Key developments include new AI chips and frameworks, as well as significant investments in data centers and cloud services to support the growing demand for AI. Science and developer communities are also leveraging AI for complex tasks, from medical research to code development, indicating a broad integration of AI across various sectors.

highlights.title: GPT-5.6: Frontier intelligence that scales with your ambition
highlights.whyItMatters: OpenAI released GPT-5.6, offering more intelligence per token and improved performance for complex tasks, signaling a new era of scalable AI capabilities.

highlights.title: ChatGPT is now a partner for your most ambitious work
highlights.whyItMatters: ChatGPT Work introduces an agent capable of performing long-running tasks across applications and files, transforming how AI assists in complex projects.

highlights.title: NVIDIA Nemotron Achieves Benchmark-Leading Performance With LangChain Deep Agents Harness
highlights.whyItMatters: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra demonstrates superior performance with LangChain's Deep Agents harness, providing high accuracy and throughput for AI agent orchestration.

highlights.title: Expanding Managed Agents in Gemini API: background tasks, remote MCP and more
highlights.whyItMatters: Google's Gemini API expands managed agents with new capabilities for reliable, production-ready AI, including background tasks and remote management.

highlights.title: AWS Lambda introduces MicroVMs
highlights.whyItMatters: AWS Lambda now offers MicroVMs for isolated sandboxes with full lifecycle control and state preservation, enhancing serverless compute capabilities.

highlights.title: OpenAI and Broadcom unveil LLM-optimized inference chip
highlights.whyItMatters: OpenAI and Broadcom introduced 'Jalapeño,' a custom AI chip designed to improve LLM inference performance and efficiency across AI systems.

highlights.title: Automate public TLS certificate issuance with ACME support in AWS Certificate Manager
highlights.whyItMatters: AWS Certificate Manager now supports ACME for automated public TLS certificate issuance and renewal, simplifying certificate management and reducing operational risk.

highlights.title: A Jupiter-size planet that escaped its star's death
highlights.whyItMatters: Scientists discovered a Jupiter-sized planet that mysteriously survived its star's red giant phase, challenging current astronomical models.

topics.name: AI
topics.summary: Rapid advancements in AI, including new models like GPT-5.6, enhanced agentic capabilities, specialized chips, and widespread enterprise adoption, continue to drive innovation across industries.

topics.name: Infrastructure
topics.summary: Significant developments in cloud infrastructure, such as AWS MicroVMs, improved caching, post-quantum security measures, and automated certificate management, are supporting the growing demands of AI and agentic systems.

topics.name: Technology
topics.summary: Innovations in technology span smart glasses, quantum computing, digital privacy regulations, and advancements in gaming and media streaming, reflecting a diverse and evolving landscape.

topics.name: Developer
topics.summary: New tools and platforms are emerging for developers, focusing on enhancing coding workflows, securing repositories, and fostering open-source collaboration, particularly in the context of AI and agentic systems.

topics.name: Science
topics.summary: Scientific breakthroughs include new insights into planetary dynamics, medical AI applications, environmental solutions, and significant milestones in space exploration and citizen science projects.
